svg.text: Mutations in “CRC” by protein position, as cBioPortal's mutation tab draws them: one stem per codon (the stored protein start position), its height the
number of distinct patient + protein change pairs there. Colour is the codon's dominant mutation type, putative drivers before VUS (driver = OncoKB
oncogenic, pinned, or a Cancer Hotspot of its kind in the stored Genome Nexus annotation; the portal also counts custom annotations). VUS and germline
mutations are included, as they are by default on the portal. Structural variants are counted as the portal's Mutations tab counts them: in the Fusion badge of
each queried partner, and in the somatic frequency of their site 1 gene only; they have no codon, so no stem, and the mutation table lists them. A
suppression floor of 3 patients per change was applied BY EACH SITE before returning anything, withholding 1,111 mutations. KRAS: somatic mutation
frequency 42.5%; mutation rows missense 2,350 driver / 3 VUS, inframe 5 driver / 0 VUS. BRAF: somatic mutation frequency 11.3%; mutation rows
missense 518 driver / 8 VUS, truncating 0 driver / 19 VUS, fusion 0 driver / 7 VUS. PIK3CA: somatic mutation frequency 20.6%; mutation rows missense
1,034 driver / 38 VUS, truncating 0 driver / 8 VUS, inframe 14 driver / 0 VUS. TP53: somatic mutation frequency 73.8%; mutation rows missense 2,616 driver
/ 26 VUS, truncating 787 driver / 0 VUS, inframe 29 driver / 0 VUS, splice 241 driver / 0 VUS, fusion 0 driver / 22 VUS.
